text:
sofia: quick mock — proposing we surface the network preflight as the very first step in the private setup flow so users catch infra issues before entering secrets. figma: https://figma.com/s/abc123
ken: +1. less churn for users. can we add a one-line explainer under the heading: 'Why we check your network'? reduces support asks.
mariah: copy nit: avoid 'allowlist' term. suggest 'Allowed IP ranges' or 'IP allow rules'. include an example CIDR: `10.0.0.0/24`.
gary: for on-prem customers, auto-detecting NAT/public IP is flaky. recommend an explicit "I have a public IP" checkbox and a fallback checklist for NAT configs.
sofia: UX question: keep this inline as an expandable section in the wizard or move to a side panel flyout? I lean inline to avoid modal context switching.
ken: accessibility: accordions must be real buttons with `aria-expanded` and we should announce failures via `role=alert`. also ensure contrast on inline status chips.
mariah: suggested heading copy for a failure state: "Connectivity check failed. Try these steps:" (short actionable). avoid long paragraphs.
preflight-bot: starting preflight run...
preflight-bot: ```
PRECHECK: DNS resolution ................ OK
PRECHECK: Outbound 443 connectivity ..... WARN (tcp handshake timeout 320ms)
PRECHECK: Required CIDR route ........... FAIL (no matching route to 10.1.0.0/16)
PRECHECK: TLS cert validation ........... OK
```
gary: can we show per-check remediation next to the check instead of dumping everything below? e.g., next to CIDR fail show: 'Show example route command' (collapsible).
sofia: a11y color nit: the warning orange we used (#ff9800) is <4.5:1 on body text. recommend #b86b00 or use bold to supplement color.
mariah: keyboard flow: after checks finish, focus should move to the first failing item so screenreader+keyboard users land where they need to act.
ken: add a primary 'Re-run checks' button inline. helper copy: 'Rerun checks without losing your entered settings.'
sofia: debating showing raw curl/traceroute logs for advanced users — show collapsed 'Advanced diagnostics' with copy and a 'Copy command' CTA.
gary: yes to collapsed raw logs. also surface a short error code per-failure so support can triage (eg PRE001_CIDR_ROUTE).
mariah: copy tweak for the 'Open ports' row: instead of 'Open port 443', write 'Allow outbound TCP port 443 (HTTPS)'. more explicit.
sofia: vote time: inline vs sidepanel for preflight UI — please react (inline/sidepanel).
mariah: inline
ken: sidepanel
gary: inline
sofia: majority inline. i'll update the mock to use an accordion + inline remediation links + advanced collapsed logs. will also patch contrast and add aria attributes in the spec. attaching updated figma: https://figma.com/s/updated-xyz
ken: tiny dev ask: can the API return a structured `checks[]` payload with `id`, `status`, `message`, `remediation_url` so the UI can render per-check CTAs?
gary: yes, we'll add `remediation_url` and `raw_output_url` for advanced logs.
sofia: thanks — i'll post final copy suggestions and updated spec by EOD. :thumbsup:
